WITH status_avgs AS (
  SELECT brokrepstat, AVG(modelconf) AS avg_modelconf
  FROM compliancecase
  GROUP BY brokrepstat
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) AS baseline_avg
  FROM status_avgs
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT s.brokrepstat, s.avg_modelconf, b.baseline_avg
  FROM status_avgs s
  CROSS JOIN baseline b
  WHERE s.avg_modelconf > b.baseline_avg
),
qualifying_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) AS mean_qualifying_avg
  FROM qualifying
)
SELECT q.brokrepstat AS status,
       q.avg_modelconf,
       q.avg_modelconf - q.baseline_avg AS avg_minus_baseline,
       q.avg_modelconf / qm.mean_qualifying_avg AS avg_divided_by_qualifying_mean
FROM qualifying q
CROSS JOIN qualifying_mean qm
WHERE q.baseline_avg IS NOT NULL
  AND qm.mean_qualifying_avg IS NOT NULL;
